person_note: Michael Brock is the controlling participating narrator. Numerous event quotes expose his I/me/my narration, including his work as a street lawyer and his concluding reflection; dialogue-only pronouns were excluded, while q00540 and q00544 retain first-person value because their external speech beats expose the narrator. The isolated sentence about Mordecai in q00552 is unmarked rather than third-person evidence. The authorized opening, scholarly identification of Michael as the first-person narrator, and interior chapter evidence agree. GradeSaver's anonymous third-person claim is demonstrably erroneous, and targeted research found no sustained alternate-person sections. The main limitation is that the authorized excerpt covers only the opening, but independent interior quotations and whole-book analyses remove material uncertainty.
